title: Lexus TZ yollarda: Markanın ilk tamamen elektrikli üç sıralı SUV modeli görüldü
summary: Lexus'un tamamen elektrikli ilk üç sıralı SUV modeli Lexus TZ, piyasaya çıkışına az kala kamuya açık alanda ilk kez görüntülendi.
body:
Lexus TZ modeli, Toyota'nın lüks otomobil markasının tamamen elektrikli ilk üç sıralı SUV aracı olarak yollarda ilk kez test sürüşü yaparken görüntülendi. Elektrikli araç, Toronto'da bir reklam çekimi sırasında kameralara yansıdı.

## Lexus TZ teknik özellikleri ve tasarımı

Electrek'in aktardığına göre araç, elektrikli Toyota Highlander BEV ile aynı platformu paylaşıyor ancak daha lüks bir seçenek olarak konumlanıyor. İki farklı batarya seçeneği sunan model; 76,96 kWh ve 95,82 kWh kapasiteli paketlerle tek şarjla yaklaşık 482 kilometre (300 mil) menzil vadediyor. Çift motorlu dört tekerlekten çekiş sistemiyle toplam 420 beygir güç üreten araç, 150 kW'a kadar şarj hızı sayesinde yüzde 10'dan yüzde 80 doluluğa yaklaşık 35 dakikada ulaşıyor. Araçta ayrıca adaptör gerektirmeden şarj imkanı sunan bir NACS portu yer alıyor.

## Donanım ve çıkış takvimi

Kabin içinde güncellenmiş sesli asistan ve özelleştirilebilir uygulamalar barındıran son nesil multimedya sistemi bulunuyor. Gövde uzunluğu 200,8 inç olan aracın fiyat bilgisi henüz açıklanmadı ancak 2026'nın sonu veya 2027'nin başı gibi satışa çıkması bekleniyor.

**Neden önemli?** Tamamen elektrikli ilk üç sıralı SUV modeli olan bu araç, markanın lüks segmentteki elektrikli araç portföyünü genişletmesi açısından dikkat çekiyor.

source_texts.title: Lexus’ electric 3-row SUV makes its first public appearance
source_texts.summary: The 2027 Lexus TZ is the first purely electric three-row SUV from Toyota’s luxury brand. Ahead of its upcoming launch, the electric TZ was spotted driving in public for the first time. more…
source_texts.text:
The 2027 Lexus TZ is the first purely electric three-row SUV from Toyota’s luxury brand. Ahead of its upcoming launch, the electric TZ was spotted driving in public for the first time.
When is Lexus launching the electric TZ?
We got our first look at the new 2027 Lexus TZ in May, an upscale sibling to the upcoming Toyota Highlander BEV.
It’s based on the same platform as the electric Highlander and will be available with two battery pack options: 76.96 kWh and 95.82 kWh, which Lexus said will deliver a driving range of up to 300 miles on a single charge.
Unlike Toyota’s 3-row SUV, all 2027 Lexus TZ models come with an “evolved” version of its DIRECT4 AWD system.
The dual-motor all-wheel drive (AWD) setup packs a combined 420 horsepower and enables it to tow up to 3,500 lbs. Drivers will be able to choose from five unique drive modes that will automatically optimize drive settings: normal, sport, eco, range, and rear comfort.
Although it uses the same platform as the Highlander EV, Lexus said the TZ will stand apart with its signature driving experience. In fact, Lexus claimed the electric TZ has the quietest cabin of any of its SUVs to date, with a fine-tuned suspension, dynamic rear steering, and a reinforced body structure.
Inside, the TZ features the latest Lexus Interface Multimedia system. The system now includes customizable apps and widgets, plus an updated “Hey Lexus” voice assistant.
The infotainment system now offers full-screen navigation and added EV charging functions, like EV Routing and an EV Range Map.
At 200.8″ long, 78.3″ wide, and 67.1″ tall, with a 120.1″ wheelbase, the Lexus TZ is about the size of other three-row EV SUVs, including the Hyundai IONIQ 9 and Volvo EX90.
With charging speeds of up to 150 kW, the electric TZ can charge from 10% to 80% in about 35 minutes. It also has a NACS port, so drivers can charge at Tesla Superchargers without needing a separate adaptor.
The 2027 Lexus TZ is expected to go on sale in late 2026 or early 2027. With its official launch coming up, the electric SUV was spotted driving in Toronto while filming a commercial.
A few images and a video of the TZ were posted on the #Torontocarspotting Facebook group (via Rigun KG) on Thursday.
Lexus has yet to announce prices for the 2027 TZ. Given that the 2027 Toyota Highlander BEV is expected to start in the mid-$50,000 range, the Lexus TZ will likely start in the mid-$60,000 range as a more upscale option.
Source: #Torontocarspotting, Rigun KG
